title: How I Got Big Workout
author: Travis O.
desc: Kickstart your fitness journey with the How I Got Big Workout, a focused 12-week program designed for newcomers eager to build strength and muscle. Comprising three sessions per week, each lasting 60 minutes, you'll engage in foundational exercises like bench presses, squats, and deadlifts, all tailored for beginners. You'll be hitting the arm muscle groups twice a week, unlike many other workouts, to get your arms bigger than ever before. With a mix of barbell and dumbbell movements, this program is perfect for those with access to a garage gym. Embrace the challenge and lay the groundwork for your fitness success!

ex.note: With chest exercises aim for 8 to 10 reps, drop weight if you can't get 8 and increase weight if you get more than 10.
With bicep exercises aim for 10 to 12 reps, drop weight if you can't get 10 and increase weight if you get more than 12.
You can also use dumbells if you prefer.
You can use dumbells if you don't have a squat rack. An alternative would be dumbell lunges.
Don't lift with arms completely straight out.  Keep them about 15° from the sides.
You can do pull-ups if you don't have cables.
